Title: LSJ: quick question about taking equipment

Messages.Author: Tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
Hello,
i need a clarification on the following:
can a vampire/minion take one(or more) equipment that has some sort of
requirement to be *played* (say, a clan) that he/she has not, from another
vampire/minion of mine that already got it on him ?
Example: can my War ghoul take the femur of toomler from a Tzmisce of mine ?

thanks in advance

Emiliano, v:ekn Prince of Rome

Messages.Author: Darka
Messages.Body:
Yes, he can take the equipment.

However, note that some equipment (ex: Enchanted Marionette) says "The
(whatever clan) with this equipment gets....." Thus a member of another
clan could take it, but couldn't use/get the bonuses from it.

DarkA
